reason: I re-ran the analysis and got the reported estimate (about 0.61, p=0.008). It holds without trimming (0.69, p=0.004) and with all the other pre-period controls (0.69), and the sign is positive in every subgroup. The report correctly leaves out the post-treatment buyer_rating_2023, which would flip the sign if included. The effect is small and observational, but the 'positive effect' conclusion is supported.
